requirements: US local business only (Yext lists supported country as United States)
Free account (name, email, password) — 'Sign in or Sign up to begin'
Required fields: business name, categories, address, main phone

preparation: Business name, US street address, main phone, website
Category, short description, hours, photos (supported fields)
workflow: Sign up for a free account
Enter business name + location and click 'Find my business' — claim if present
Otherwise fill the form (name, category, address, phone, website, description), accept T&C, 'Create Listing'
CitySquares reviews before publishing — reportedly up to 24 hours
watchFor: Site 403s automated fetches — use a real browser
Local-business fit only: an online SaaS without a US location doesn't belong
Paid Enhanced Listings and an API Partner Program ($0.12/listing/mo) exist — free tier is basic
Listings are SEO-optimized profile pages; link value is a citation, not a launch
countsAsLive: The business profile page is publicly reachable on citysquares.com and appears in its city/category search
